connection_fields.name: host
connection_fields.description: workspace host, e.g. adb-123.4.azuredatabricks.net

connection_fields.name: http_path
connection_fields.description: the SQL warehouse's HTTP path, e.g. /sql/1.0/warehouses/abc

connection_fields.name: auth_type
connection_fields.description: pat (a token) or oauth (browser sign-in; with client_id and client_secret, a service principal)

connection_fields.name: token
connection_fields.description: personal access token, for auth_type pat

connection_fields.name: client_id
connection_fields.description: OAuth client; a service principal's application ID (browser sign-in defaults to databricks-cli)

connection_fields.name: client_secret
connection_fields.description: service principal OAuth secret

connection_fields.name: catalog
connection_fields.description: default catalog

connection_fields.name: schema
connection_fields.description: default schema

connection_fields.name: profile
connection_fields.description: a ~/.databrickscfg profile to sign in with (auth_type auto)

connection_fields.name: scopes
connection_fields.description: OAuth scopes

connection_fields.name: redirect_port
connection_fields.description: the localhost port browser sign-in redirects to (default 8020)

connection_fields.name: retry_timeout
connection_fields.description: seconds to keep waiting while a stopped warehouse starts (default 900)

connection_fields.name: retries
connection_fields.description: how many times to try again after a temporary error (0: never): connecting, or a Volume or workspace upload
